title: Software Diagnostics & Performance Test Engineer
description:
**SOTI is committed to providing its employees with endless possibilities; learning new things, working with the latest technologies and making a difference in the world.**
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

***SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.***
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.
* Mentor other engineers in systematic debugging and root-cause analysis.

**Must-have qualifications**

**1. Technical**

* 5+ years of software engineering, performance engineering, systems engineering, reliability engineering, production troubleshooting, or a closely related discipline, preferably in a product-based software company.
* Programming/debugging ability in at least one major language such as **Java, C++, C#, Python**, etc.
* Strong ability to read and understand unfamiliar application code.
* Demonstrated experience troubleshooting complex software problems.
* Strong understanding of operating-system concepts: processes, threads, memory, CPU, file I/O, sockets, synchronization, resource utilization
* Strong understanding of networking fundamentals: TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS, connection management, latency, timeouts, retransmissions
* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.

**2. Behavioral**

* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.
* Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly.
* Comfortable collaborating with developers without simply handing problems back to them.
* Strong ownership of difficult investigations

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**A. Procurement Planning and Execution**

· Prepare procurement plans based on project schedules, material requirements and approved budgets.

· Coordinate with Project Managers, Site Engineers, Planning, QS and Proposal teams to identify material requirements in advance.

· Ensure timely procurement and delivery of construction materials to avoid project delays.

· Monitor purchase requisitions, purchase orders, delivery schedules, and pending supplies.

· Prioritize urgent site requirements while maintaining proper approval procedures.

**B. Vendor and Supplier Management**

· Identify, evaluate and recommend suitable vendors and suppliers in accordance with company policy.

· Obtain and compare quotations based on price, quality, delivery time, payment terms and service support.

· Negotiate prices, credit periods, discounts, transportation costs and other commercial terms.

· Develop and maintain a reliable supplier network for construction materials, equipment and services.

· Conduct periodic vendor performance evaluations and address supply-related issues.

**C. Cost Control and Commercial Management**

· Ensure purchases are within approved project budgets and authorized financial limits.

· Monitor material price trends and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.

· Coordinate with QS and Accounts teams for budget verification, invoice reconciliation and payment-related matters.

· Track procurement savings, price variations and budget deviations.

· Ensure purchases are supported by approved requisitions, comparative statements, purchase orders and required documents.

**D. Quality and Delivery Control**

· Ensure materials comply with approved specifications, drawings, quality standards and project requirements.

· Coordinate with project teams and quality personnel regarding material approvals and technical compliance.

· Monitor supplier commitments, delivery schedules, material shortages and rejected or damaged materials.

· Coordinate resolution of quality complaints, replacements, shortages and delivery discrepancies.

**E. Team Management and Process Compliance**

· Supervise and guide procurement executives, purchase officers, and other team members.

· Allocate responsibilities and monitor individual and departmental performance.

· Implement procurement SOPs, approval procedures, documentation standards and vendor evaluation systems.

· Maintain updated records of vendors, quotations, purchase orders, material rates and procurement commitments.

· Ensure compliance with company policies, financial authority limits and applicable statutory requirements.

**F. Reporting and Coordination**

· Submit regular procurement status reports to management.

· Report critical material shortages, delayed supplies, price increases and procurement risks.

· Coordinate with Projects, Planning, QS, Accounts, Stores and other departments to resolve procurement issues.

· Prepare dashboards covering purchase commitments, delivery status, budget variances, savings and supplier performance.

**3. EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATION AND EXPERIENCE**

· Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

· Typically 5–8 years of relevant procurement or purchase experience, preferably in the construction industry.

· Experience managing procurement teams and handling multiple construction projects is preferred.

· Knowledge of construction materials, supplier markets, commercial negotiations and procurement documentation is essential.

**4. REQUIRED SKILLS AND COMPETENCIES**

· Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.

· Sound knowledge of construction materials, specifications, and market rates.

· Budget monitoring, cost analysis, and commercial decision-making.

· Procurement planning and material scheduling.

· Team leadership and interdepartmental coordination.

· Proficiency in MS Excel and procurement/ERP software.

· Strong analytical, communication, problem-solving, and reporting skills.

· High integrity, accountability, and attention to detail.

* Experience in preparing technical submittals, material take-offs, cable schedules, and as-built drawings.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
* Good communication, coordination, and teamwork abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.

title: MARINE ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
description:
A **Marine Electrical Engineer** is responsible for designing, installing, testing, and maintaining the electrical, electronic, and power generation systems aboard ships, offshore platforms, and marine structures. They ensure that all electrical equipment complies with international maritime standards, operates efficiently, and maintains safety at sea.

Key Responsibilities

* **System Design & Installation:** Design and oversee the installation of marine electrical systems, including power generation (generators, alternators), distribution switchboards, lighting, propulsion control, and navigation systems.
* **Maintenance & Troubleshooting:** Conduct routine inspections, diagnostic tests, and preventive/corrective maintenance on electrical machinery and automation systems to minimize downtime.
* **Compliance & Safety:** Ensure all electrical systems comply with regulations set by classification societies (e.g., DNV, Lloyd's Register) and international maritime bodies (e.g., IMO, SOLAS, IEEE).
* **Automation & Control:** Work with programmable logic controllers (PLCs), instrumentation, alarm monitoring systems, and dynamic positioning (DP) systems.
* **Project Management:** Collaborate with naval architects, marine engineers, and shipyard personnel during dry-docking, retrofits, and new-build construction projects.
* **Documentation:** Maintain accurate technical logs, electrical schematics, inventory records, and safety reports.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Marine Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **Certifications:** Relevant STCW certifications (for seagoing roles), such as Electro-Technical Officer (ETO) certification or High Voltage certification, depending on vessel type.
* **Experience:** 2+ years of experience working in shipyards, maritime operations, or offshore energy sectors.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Deep understanding of AC/DC power systems, high-voltage networks, motor controls, switchboards, and marine automation/navigational equipment.

Preferred Skills & Competencies

* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical faults under high-pressure conditions at sea.
* **Communication:** Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills to coordinate with multi-national crew members and shore-based management.
* **Physical Fitness:** Ability to pass required marine medical examinations and work in confined or hazardous environments.

* Good communication and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple service calls.
* Willingness to travel to customer locations as required.
* Valid driving license and ability to travel locally is preferred.

Experience in the following areas will be an added advantage:

* Gaming PCs and professional workstations
* Servers and server hardware
* GPU-based and AI systems
* Networking equipment and basic network troubleshooting
* CCTV and related IT infrastructure
* UPS and power-related IT equipment
* Hardware warranty and RMA processes
* Preventive maintenance contracts (AMC)

* First-time resolution rate
* Customer satisfaction
* Reduction in repeat service calls
* Accuracy of service reports and documentation
* Proper handling and tracking of replaced components
* Compliance with service response and resolution timelines
* Quality of installation, repair, and preventive maintenance
* Effective coordination with internal teams

This is primarily a **field-based technical role** requiring regular travel to customer locations for installation, troubleshooting, repair, preventive maintenance, and system upgrades. The engineer may be required to work outside normal business hours occasionally based on customer requirements and critical service situations.

**Ideal Candidate:**The ideal candidate should be a **hands-on IT hardware professional** who enjoys troubleshooting and solving technical problems at customer locations. The candidate must be technically competent, customer-friendly, disciplined in service documentation, and capable of working under time constraints while maintaining high-quality service standards.
